analysis.rationale: JPEG confirmed by 0%-FP block_boundary; blur confirmed by isotropic gradient/MTF signals and by monotone PSNR gains with blur severity; noise excluded by sigma<2 and variance analysis. Best achievable deterministic reproduction is blur_gaussian:3 -> compression_jpeg:4 (26.29 dB, CI 7/10), reproduced on support pair 1 (26.43 dB, CI 7/10) with the same CI failure pattern (dark-clipping only), which confirms a systematic residual rather than content-specific error. The residual is a real affine contrast compression (~0.84) plus chroma reduction visible on all 5 pairs that no legal single function matches exactly; closest legal candidates are kept in alternatives for training-PSNR arbitration.
